chunks.heading: Subway Encounter — The Teen / The Commuter
chunks.notes: The Teen literally practices his self-image in the window reflection and misreads the Commuter's annoyed glare as the attention he was performing for.

chunks.heading: Job Interview — The Applicant / The Interviewer

chunks.heading: Grocery Aisle — The Widow / The Cashier
chunks.notes: The Widow's cereal box is explicitly a memory-object tied to her dead husband ("a morning that used to have two mugs"), and the Cashier is the quiet, attentive witness who "recognizes the ritual" without naming it.
